translations.web: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me;” says the Lord, “I will repay.” Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
translations.bsb: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
translations.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
translations.asv: For we know him that said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
